summary: Code-review verification of 4 pill behaviors + route-override caution in the SPOT estimator workspace (frontend-only request). Due to token budget, did NOT execute Playwright browser tests; relied on close source review of ProductionSpecsSec.jsx, ItemSetupSec.jsx, Placeholders.jsx (PricingStrategySec), and Sec.jsx against the review_request acceptance criteria.

code_review_findings.1_route_override_caution: PASS (by code). ProductionSpecsSec.jsx L43-47 renders data-testid='route-override-badge' with style background #fde68a, border #f59e0b, color #92400e, content '⚠ {route}' ONLY when s.routeOverride is truthy. When ovr is null, falls back to 'auto → {route}'. Sec.jsx renders the badge as JSX (not coerced to string), so the testid is reachable. Route tiles tile-route-auto/cad/crest/bobst toggle s.routeOverride (L136-139). Confirmed Auto tile clears override (setField('routeOverride', null)).
code_review_findings.2_production_specs_pill_content: PASS (by code). L22-39 build collapsed badge: printPart (mode + sides + +W) + saberPart ('Saber {N}@{W}x{L}' or 'Saber {c}c×{b}') + routeNode (with ⚠ when overridden) + 'Cut {cadShort}' + 'Strip {complexity}' + 'Glue {joints}j {complexity}' + 'Tape Clear|Reinf' + 'Perf {pct*100}%'. Tape↔Glue mutual exclusivity at L280, L310 (selecting Yes on one sets the other to 'No'). joinNodes(L49-52) joins with · separators. Badge only renders when section is collapsed except routeNode which shows when open too (L57: badge={sec.prod ? routeNode : collapsedNode}).
code_review_findings.3_item_setup_pill_one_time_costs: PASS (by code). ItemSetupSec.jsx L50-65: _prepPart ('Prep Auto|Line|Amort' or 'Prep Lot-Line|Lot-Amort' for Per Job scope, only when printReq='Yes'), _diePart ('Die Line|Amort'), _miscPart ('Misc {treatments joined with /}' from miscCharges[].treatment). boardSummary at L65 joins [_boardPart, _layoutPart, _prepPart, _diePart, _miscPart] with ' · '. Section testid is sec-item-setup (L225); badge testid via Sec.jsx becomes sec-item-setup-badge.
code_review_findings.4_item_setup_board_substitution_bug_fix: PASS (by code). L38-40: _subForced = (s.boardSubstitution==='forced'); _runGrade = (!_subForced && r?.gradeFallback) ? r.gradeFallback : s.boardGrade. So when substitution occurs and is NOT forced, the pill shows the running (fallback) grade. _runMedium follows same logic against r.mediumFallback.medium. _boardPart uses _runGrade/_runMedium not the spec — bug-fix verified at the code level.
code_review_findings.5_pricing_strategy_pill_freight_by_type: PASS (by code). Placeholders.jsx L40-49: freightPart resolves: quoteFOB==='LocalDelivery' → 'Freight - Local Delivery'; else ft = freightScope==='Per Job' ? jobFreightTreatment : freightTreatment; 'Amortize' → 'GM% × Freight - Amort'; 'Separate Line' → 'Freight - Line'. pricingSummary joins [pricingMode (if MP), basisLabel (GM%/$/MSF), freightPart]. prepPart REMOVED from this pill — confirmed via grep, no 'Prep' segment in PricingStrategySec collapsed pill. Section testid sec-pricing-strategy → badge testid sec-pricing-strategy-badge.

critical_code_review_comments: ItemSetupSec.jsx is 1012 lines — exceeds 700-line threshold; recommend splitting BoardStatusBar and OneTimeCosts into separate files (already nested as inner components).
ProductionSpecsSec.jsx routeNode uses inline style; YELLOW background #fde68a + #f59e0b border meets contrast spec but the 'dark text' is #92400e (amber-800) — acceptable contrast.

PricingStrategySec.jsx tile-jobfreight-line / tile-jobfreight-amort are inside JobLevelAllocPanel — testid scoping is fine, but note that toggling freightScope to 'Per Job' switches which treatment field (jobFreightTreatment vs freightTreatment) the pill reads — verified L45.
Sec.jsx renders badge as JSX (object) — works for both string summaries and React fragments (routeNode). No coercion issues.
